title: Le Francais par le film. No. 01
brief_description: Comprises twelve graduated lessons, each of which introduces a typical scene of french life and customs and stresses some part of French grammar. This first episode is an introduction to the characters - a French family. Stresses pronunciation of certain French vowels and consonants.
